name: agent-workbench
description: Bypass observation workbench for coding agents and program internals.

scripts.build: pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/observation-schema build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/timeline build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/codex-adapter build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/project-observation build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/local-database build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/review build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/desktop build
scripts.review:test:codex: pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/local-database build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/review build && node scripts/run-review-with-codex.mjs
scripts.review:run:observation: pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/codex-adapter build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/project-observation build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/local-database build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/review build && node scripts/run-review-from-codex-observation.mjs
scripts.review:acceptance:local: pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/codex-adapter build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/project-observation build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/local-database build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/review build && node scripts/run-local-review-acceptance.mjs
scripts.review:local: pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/local-database build && pnpm --filter @agent-workbench/review build && node scripts/manage-review-local.mjs
